MagnetiX™ - Stackable Full-Arch Surgery System

A stackable guided workflow for predictable full-arch implant outcomes from surgery to final restoration.

MagnetiX™ transforms complex All-on-X procedures into a structured, repeatable system where prosthetic planning and surgical sequencing are aligned before the first incision.

MagnetiX™ features magnetic attachments to ensure maximum retention between components throughout the stackable procedure.

Start a Full-Arch Case Book a Fine-Tuning Session

Full-Arch

Surgery & Restoration

MagnetiX™ GFMR and GFMP were developed to eliminate uncertainty in full-arch implant dentistry through a structured, collaborative workflow.

Unlike conventional guided surgery, every MagnetiX™ case undergoes mandatory review and validation with a 3DDX dentist before production begins. Prosthetic design, Implant positioning, Guide sequencing, and Restorative objectives are aligned in advance so execution becomes controlled rather than reactive.

The MagnetiX™ GFMR Workflow

Four Steps One Connected System

01

Prosthetically Driven Planning

Your validated records are transformed into a precise digital treatment plan, driven by the restoration design that feeds implant treatment planning.

02

Stackable surgical guides

Sequential guides—including Pin Positioning Guide (PPG), Bone Reduction Guide (BRG), and Implant Surgical Guide (ISG) provide structured surgical progression.

03

Controlled Immediate Provisionalization Workflow GFMR

Pre-fabricated stackable pickup restoration, ready for intraoral pickup.
Two MagnetiX PMMAs are included in the package!

04

Transition to Final Restorations

Whether you proceed with physical records using the backup provisional or digital records via photogrammetry, 3DDX will support you to deliver the definitive zirconia restorations with passive-fit, high functionality, and superior esthetics.

Two Pathways, One System

Temporary Restoration Pathways

Prefabricated Temporaries (GFMR)

Guided full mouth Restoration

Stackable pickup restorations, designed before surgery and delivered immediately following implant placement

Designed to Deliver

  • Same-day fixed restorations for immediate function
  • Restoratively driven workflows to reduce chairside adjustments

Best For

  • Guided surgery for accurate implant placement
  • Same-day treatment protocols for full-arch rehabilitation

Chairside Support Available

  • Temporary restoration pickup
  • Restoration refinement and finishing
  • Coordination to avoid hiccups during surgery

Post-Fabricated Temporaries (GFMP & FMP)

Guided Full Mouth Photogrammetry & Full mouth Photogrammetry

Screw-retained restorations, fabricated after surgery and implant placement using verified implant position capture. This works for guided or freehand surgeries.

Supported Technologies

  • Photogrammetry systems
  • Grammetry workflows X

Designed to Deliver

  • Micron-level accuracy for passive provisional fit
  • Restorative flexibility, for freehand or guided surgery
  • Predictable progression toward final restorations

Chairside Photogrammetry Support Available

  • Helping clinicians to capture verified implant positions, accelerating provisionalization.

Every MagnetiX™ Case Is Clinically Validated

An online fine-tuning session with a 3DDX dentist is mandatory for all MagnetiX™ cases.

During this collaborative review, clinicians can:

  • Confirm prosthetic design and prosthetic space

  • Validate implant positioning

  • Refine angulation and depth

  • Review surgical sequencing

  • Align treatment with final restorative objectives

Expertly designed surgical guides for
stress-free, safe and predictable surgeries

Drill-deviation detection

MagnetiX™ surgical guide components will detach from each other if the drill deviates from its planned direction and orientation. Only when the drill is appropriately positioned will the components stay attached and permit drilling. This prevents the operator from drilling in the wrong direction and allows for more accurate achievement of the planned implant position

Key Benefits

Why Leading Clinicians Choose MagnetiX™

Expert Clinical Validation

Every case undergoes rigorous review and collaborative fine-tuning by 3DDX dentists, resolving critical decisions before surgery and ensuring alignment between the surgical and restorative phases.

Proprietary Stackable Technology

Our self-aligning MagnetiX™ guide system simplifies surgical execution, and provides enhanced control and repeatable consistency throughout complex procedures

Restoration-First Approach

Planning is driven by the definitive prosthetic design, anchoring implant placement in long-term functional and aesthetic predictability while maintaining a logical, streamlined restorative journey

Photogrammetry-Integrated Precision

The workflow is optimized for high-precision digital capture, supporting accurate implant positioning and seamless passive-fit restoration workflows.

Scalable Clinical Workflows

Refined protocols and structured sequencing reduce chairside time and overall treatment timelines while helping advanced practices standardize and scale high-performance full-arch treatment

Flexible Production Pathways

Choose between 3DDX-fabricated physical guides or digital design files for rapid in-office 3D printing, giving practices the flexibility to integrate the workflow into their preferred production model.
